title: Binops [+, -, *, /, %
description:
In TypeScript there are 5 mathmatical binary operators (that means take 2 inputs), +, -, *, /, and %. +, -, *, and / are addition subtraction multiplication and division, what you would expect. Then, there is %. % Stands for modulus. It outputs the _remainder_ of a division.
